answer: An agent economy can weight each identity’s voting power by collateral locked for 30 days, making committed capital the signal of influence. Splitting 100 tokens across a thousand identities still buys only 100 tokens of voting weight, so a swarm gains nothing from extra names. To gain more influence, an attacker must lock more capital and bear its opportunity cost. Each identity is an ember; multiplying them cannot strengthen the thread of votes without more fuel.
